lines: Dr. Dharminder Kumar Nagar, role unknown, is set to receive money from selling 4,329,004 Equity Shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹300.00 crore are due on or about Wednesday, October 28, 2026, per the offer document's timetable.
Retained shares are an estimate of ₹4,794.88 crore at offer price, so a later conversation on that holding may matter.
Role is unknown and the listing is not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
